scope: All 135 numbered result rows from the surviving PropertyAuctions AID 682 grid for the 21 June 2010 Savills National sale. The archived first-party Savills page identifies the sale date and states a total of 135 lots across seven catalogue pages; its first 20 rows reconcile one-for-one with the secondary grid on lot number, locality and result, apart from the first-party type label for lot 19 being undefined. The secondary page's stale Offered: 130 summary is not used as the denominator because the same page visibly contains lots 1 through 135 and the first-party total is 135. Street addresses are unavailable for 134 rows and remain null; lot 38 preserves its separately recovered exact address and description under the existing stable appearance ID.
